_comment: DRISHTI analytics RDS network posture (Prompt 14 Part F, item 2). RDS is a PRIVATE, read-only analytics adapter behind the AWS model plane — NEVER the operational CRUD path (that is Catalyst Data Store) and NEVER reachable from the browser. This descriptor is the reviewed source of the required network controls; enforce it in the Console/IaC and verify the browser side with infra/aws/check_no_db_url_in_web.py.

network.placement: private subnets only (DB subnet group across 2+ AZs)

ingress.note: SG-to-SG only: PostgreSQL 5432 is reachable ONLY from the protected AWS adapter's security group (Lambda/ECS in private subnets).

forbidden_ingress.reason: F.2: never open PostgreSQL 5432 to the internet.
no public ingress to the DB at all.

network.vpc_endpoints: adapter reaches SageMaker/Batch/S3 via VPC endpoints; RDS never egresses to the internet.

encryption.in_transit: TLS required (parameter group rds.force_ssl=1); client db_sslmode=require
encryption.auth: IAM DB authentication preferred (no static password); role drishti_readonly (NOLOGIN app role assumed read-only).

access_rules.operational_crud_path: Catalyst Data Store — RDS is NOT used for operational CRUD.
access_rules.database_url_scope: server-side AppSail env ONLY; in the AppSail deploy descriptor DATABASE_URL is in must_not_set_for_crud and readiness never hard-requires it.
access_rules.browser: React/Slate must NEVER receive a DATABASE_URL, a 5432 endpoint, an RDS host, or any DB credential. Only VITE_* public values ship to the browser.
access_rules.adapter_usage: read-only PostGIS/pgRouting queries, only-where-necessary, via the drishti_readonly role.

verification.browser_leak_check: python infra/aws/check_no_db_url_in_web.py  (fails CI if a DB URL/5432/RDS host/server secret key appears in the web source or committed env).
verification.bundle_check: web/scripts/check-bundle-secrets.mjs  (fails the build if a secret-shaped string reaches dist/).
verification.app_side: services/ml/app/config.py keeps database_url server-side (sslmode=require); /health/ready never hard-requires RDS; appsail.deploy.json must_not_set_for_crud=[DATABASE_URL].
